articles.title: Rubio says 'no imminent threat' to US from Iran
articles.summary: Rubio says 'no imminent threat' to US from Iran US Secretary of State Marco Rubio cast doubt about reports of an "imminent threat" from Iran on Washington. Speaking to reporters in the Philippines, Rubio said that US authorities routinely check for  potential threats against the country, but added that most intelligence leads are not considered credible.  When asked if he was concerned about a possible attack on Washington, he said: "I am not. But again, we're concerned every day about anything that threatens our country ... I don't think there's any imminent threat."
